capabilities.complete_execution: At most one model-selected changed candidate, complete simulation, unchanged reach evaluation and sampled holding/profile feedback.
capabilities.local_comparison: Optional one paired local comparison, two solves, <=300 charged seconds, at a saved baseline update with effective horizon 0.01 s; select one changed positive weight. Existing previous-input cold seed and integration retained. Unavailable/inconclusive screening does not prohibit a justified complete experiment.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Diagnose the new common baseline. Only terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight may later change under the explicit control grant. A reasonable testable hypothesis is enough to justify bounded exploration; proof of the dominant cause is not required. No geometry or material changes. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.

request_content.question: Open question on the bound baseline-replay inventory (execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, candidate baseline-replay, controller 8f837eb4…, 35 retained controller updates): terminal reach, sampled holding position, sampled holding speed and computation are reported together but disagree, and I want the relationship described rather than a cause asserted. (a) Terminal reach passes: reach_passed = true [f70952bb7daa1] with terminal tip error 0.007642608585867386 m [fff8ec664f4de] against the 0.01 m position limit [f12f1083f9849]; but joint_reach_holding_passed = false [f2bba4a48898d]. (b) Sampled holding position fails: holding_position_passed = false [f5ba2ab7e1107], and in the final holding window (6 selected samples, times 0.3–0.35 s [fa54c1ae23d4d, f5cdbebaa75dc]) tip error ranges 0.007642608585867386–0.05813810428573256 m [fb702504e6820, f321fd1d899fd], above the same 0.01 m limit. (c) Sampled holding speed fails: holding_speed_passed = false [fba496b7b7707], window tip speed ranges 0.6351726092425104–1.5810152739742807 m/s [f952823a6555c, ff296c4b0c654] against the 0.02 m/s speed limit [f4ab3008c7e24], with terminal tip speed 0.6351726092425104 m/s [ffad04d70b19c]; sampled_settling_passed = false [f641da2506e2e]. (d) Computation: 35 of 35 updates missed deadline [f4df9eb21672e] against a 0.01 s control period [fd007fcdf7be2], mean update 17.26331904856488 s [f071fab261a7e], and 35 updates [fd29a12daa2da] with stopping counts 34 User_Requested_Stop vs 1 Solve_Succeeded [f5c2fb5a6d4cc, f88b1091f6e15]; full_snapshots_available = false [ff7afc7fe179a]. Specific questions: (1) Is the terminal reach pass a property of one sampled endpoint only, distinct from the whole-trajectory holding behavior, given that the holding-window error maximum exceeds the reach tolerance? (2) Are holding-window position, holding-window speed and per-update computation best reported as co-occurring but separately scoped observations (terminal reach, holding position, holding speed, computation each independently), with sample coverage at most 6 rows and 35 updates? (3) Can the retained evidence support any statement linking the holding-window position/speed excursions to the computation record, or does it only support temporal co-occurrence? Report each answer as retrieved, not displayed, not retained, or not computable, and note that retained limitations state no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed [f1f3274ca3bd7] and that a single execution does not establish a dominant cause [f15daf227e33d]; also note that a bounded projected-model probe (effective horizon <=0.01 s) is known to be insufficient to explain an entire settling failure and is not the basis of this question.
scope: Retained-evidence reading and reporting only: JSON reads and derived diagnosis.inspect_evidence views over the bound inventory entries source.one_step_predictions, source.saved_projected_states, source.plan_selection, source.solver_status, source.controller_horizon, source.backend_motion and source.force_limits, using update_ids 0..34 or explicit named subsets (max 8 ids per query) and time_range_s for sampled backend motion.

Already read in this context (stated coverage): common_summary handoff (73 handles); evidence.read root of artifact 1dd73248… (content offset 0, 5 of 12 items); evidence.read /34/measured_initial_state (5 of 24 values, update_id 34 only); evidence.read /34/one_step_prediction (5 of 9 items, update_id 34 only).

Explicitly excluded here: production changes, controller configuration changes, and any backend execution or complete simulation. No saved-state numerical grant (prediction_braking / local_comparison) is requested in this phase; the phase numerical limits remain local_solves 2 and prediction_evaluations 0, both unused, and this request performs no solve or evaluation.

Known non-retained / unavailable for this question: control_snapshots.json (full warm plans, optimizer iteration traces) is not retained [source.historical_full_plans]; raw gzip backend motion bytes are not readable as JSON via evidence.read and must be accessed through the derived motion view; per-update effective_horizon is retained for update_ids 0..34 but only as control intervals, not as a trajectory.
Causal attribution is out of scope: no closed-loop counterfactual replay tool exists in this context, so any linkage statement must be limited to temporal co-occurrence.
stopping_conditions: Stop when terminal reach, sampled holding-window position, sampled holding-window speed and computation have each been stated as separate fact-handled observations with their coverage (6 rows of the final 0.05 s window; 35 retained updates; terminal endpoint update 34 / t=0.35 s), or explicitly marked not displayed, not read in this context, not retained, or not computable.

Stop when it has been stated whether the terminal reach pass is confined to a single sampled endpoint and whether holding-window position/speed excursions can be related to the computation record beyond temporal co-occurrence, without asserting a dominant cause.

Stop when further enquiry would require a capability not available here (closed-loop counterfactual replay, control_snapshots.json, or a bounded projected-model probe longer than the permitted <=0.01 s effective horizon) and that gap is declared explicitly rather than filled by inference.

Stop when any threshold observation (0.01 m position limit, 0.02 m/s speed limit, 0.05 s window, 0.01 s control period, 10 ms deadline) is reported as a fact with its handle and not as a proven cause of the observed excursion.
